note: 0132 on the console: with frame generation off, the 2 it leaves in retroarch.cfg is replaced by one present per game frame (the log says so) and the game runs at 60 frames a second; turned off from its menu mid-game, the video output is reinitialized (a 2.5 s gap) and the same happens at once.
must_contain: [FrameGen] Off: each game frame is presented once (2 presents were kept).
